mapper.insert: insert into ums_sms_code (phone, code, biz_type, status, ip, expire_time) values (#{phone}, #{code}, #{bizType}, #{status}, #{ip}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: select * from ums_sms_code where phone = #{phone} and biz_type = #{bizType} order by create_time desc limit 1
mapper.update: update ums_sms_code set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from ums_sms_code where phone = #{phone} and create_time > date_sub(now(), interval #{minutes} minute)
